deployments_detail.use: AI Peak Integration for MassHunter: cloud-based ML software that mimics analytical chemists to automate manual peak detection and integration in GC/MS data analysis (e.g. phthalates, TDCPP), with a customer-unique ML model trained per workflow. Deployed commercial product. [Agilent (in-house, built on Virtual Control ACIES tech)]

Acquisition of Virtual Control's ACIES AI/ML technology to automate labor-intensive GC/MS and LC/MS data analysis, integrated into Agilent MassHunter and lab informatics platforms. [Virtual Control (acquired by Agilent)]

SWARM autotune: AI-based (particle swarm optimization) autotune for LC/MS (LC/TQ, LC/Q-TOF) instruments that automatically tunes the mass spectrometer for application-specific, expert-level results. Embedded in shipping instruments. [Agilent (in-house)]

xCELLigence RTCA eSight AI: AI-powered software module for label-free live-cell imaging that automates cell segmentation and eliminates user-dependent parameter tuning for biopharma research. Newly launched commercial module. [Agilent (in-house)]

Partnership with Visiopharm to co-promote/distribute AI-driven precision digital pathology image analysis (e.g. breast, PD-L1 tumor region selection) integrated with Agilent Dako pathology workflows for cancer diagnostics. [Visiopharm]

Partnership with PathAI to deliver AI-powered companion diagnostic (CDx) assay development for biopharma and clinical applications, combining Agilent assays with PathAI's AISight/AISight DX+ digital pathology algorithms (e.g. AIM-PD-L1 for NSCLC). [PathAI]

Integration of NVIDIA Clara Parabricks (GPU-accelerated genomic analysis) with Agilent's Alissa Reporter software, running on AWS, to speed up genomic data analysis for clinical labs and researchers. [NVIDIA (Clara Parabricks), AWS]

Enterprise-wide collaboration with OpenAI and BCG to identify, build and scale applied AI solutions across Agilent's products (instruments, software, services), operations and customer workflows; also joined the OpenAI Partner Network. [OpenAI, BCG]
Acquired Sigsense (AI lab-operations optimization, 2024); OpenAI+BCG collaboration to deploy AI across products/operations (Jun 2026)
CrossLab Connect digital services platform providing AI-driven insights on lab instruments to reduce downtime, enable predictive maintenance and data-driven lab optimization. [Agilent (in-house)]
Customer-service AI chatbot deployment using Sobot's omnichannel workbench and AI tools to handle routine inquiries 24/7 and intelligently route customers to agents. [Sobot]
deployments_detail.value: 6x efficiency increase, 25% cost reduction, 95% customer satisfaction score
